metadata.description:
A 2000 airing of Cartoon Network's Cartoon Cartoon Friday's Block, featuring bumpers and commercials.

Episodes Included in Order:
Johnny Bravo: "Hunted!"
Cow and Chicken: "A Couple of Skating Fools" 
Dexter's Laboratory: "My Favorite Martian"
Johnny Bravo: "Dental Hijinks"
Johnny Bravo: "Little Red Riding Johnny"
Johnny Bravo: "Pouch Potato"
Dexter's Laboratory: "Sister's Got a Brand New Bag"
Dexter's Laboratory: "Shoo-Shee Gnomes"
Dexter's Laboratory: "Lab of the Lost"
The Powerpuff Girls: "A Very Special Blossom"
The Powerpuff Girls: "Daylight Savings"
Mike, Lu and Og: "Nobody's Nose"
Mike, Lu and Og: "Scuba Doobie Doo"
Sheep in the Big City: "To Bleat or Not to Bleat"
Courage the Cowardly Dog: "The Hunchback of Nowhere"
Courage the Cowardly Dog: "The Gods Must Be Goosey"
Ed, Edd n Eddy: "Urban Ed"
Ed, Edd n Eddy: "Stop, Look and Ed"

All footage included belongs to its original owners, and has been uploaded to preserve the TV broadcasts.
